label: Early copy phase (output orig(1)), long sequences, b/f/h/z coming up
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost entirely at its start: 81% of activation mass is at recall_idx 1 (the step right after <DEL>, input orig(0), output orig(1)), 18% at recall_idx 2, and about 1% at the <DEL> step itself. It never fires during the original phase or after recall_idx 3. Within that window the rate is much higher for long sequences (L=9 holds 56% of mass, L 3-6 little) and when the next few outputs (orig(1..3)) include b, f, h or z (5-7x lift for out_tok/next_out in that set). The firing step is set by position; whether it fires is set by length and the upcoming tokens. Only 10% of recall_idx==1 steps are active, so precision is limited: dev F1 is about 0.41 with mass recall 0.59. Top activations are long sequences with b/f/h/z at orig(1..3), e.g. c b f z ... and q b z z ....
